scope: Frontend 1.4.16 (source, not yet published) with app 1.6.11 (unchanged): works with HA 2026.11 - the dial follows the confirmed value after a dropped tap. On HA 2026.11 (frontend 20261028, PendingValueSync in the native target control) a +/- tap the card or popup drops unsent (target, phase or basis change inside the 250 ms send window, connection or session lost, popup closed, a refused request, + and - back on the confirmed value) left the native dial on the never-sent number and deaf to later states until reopened; the shared control lease now releases that native hold and copies the displayed state back (no-op on earlier frontends). Reproduced and confirmed fixed in a throwaway HA Core 2026.11.2 on the build host (synthetic loopback data, real adapter code). tests/test-native-202611.mjs runs the pinned HA 20261028.6 native bodies against card and popup, both circuits (53 cases, 28 fail on 1.4.15). No new service call; correction-only and target contracts unchanged. No HACS/HA installation, real HA service call or physical acceptance is claimed.
